source_definition.value: Advertisement image condition/type: alcohol, food, cars, or technology; the primary contrast was ALCOHOL > CONTROL, with cars and technology serving as non-appetitive controls and food as an appetitive control in subset analyses.

model_settings.value: Voxelwise general linear models included task effects, a session mean, a linear trend, and six realignment motion parameters; task regressors were convolved with a canonical hemodynamic response function. Individual contrast images were entered into a group-level random-effects analysis. Whole-brain inference used a voxelwise p<.01 threshold and a minimum cluster size of 600 contiguous voxels, cluster-level p<.001, based on 10,000 Monte Carlo simulations with AFNI 3dClustSim and its spatial autocorrelation function.

description.value: Functional images were preprocessed with SPM8-based tools: slice-acquisition timing differences were corrected, images were realigned within and across runs to correct head movement, unwarped to correct residual movement-related distortions, normalized to ICBM 152 MNI standard stereotaxic space at 3-mm isotropic resolution, and spatially smoothed with an 8-mm FWHM Gaussian kernel. AFNI 3dClustSim was used for cluster-size correction.
